segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin describe good wear and blendability, though several say they still need to set it with powder to avoid shine, and one found it clogged pores.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report a hydrating, non-drying finish with a nice glow, and several use it as their main base instead of foundation.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers (oily and flaky/peeling at once) say it stays weightless and blends well but can highlight dry, flaky patches.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive, eczema-prone or allergy-prone skin repeatedly report no irritation or reaction, though one reviewer with very sensitive skin had severe clogged pores and settling into lines.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention their age (40s) or mature skin say it sits well on fine lines without looking cakey and that it helps cover age spots and sun damage.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for sun damage, age spots, or fine lines say it conceals age spots and doesn't settle into fine lines; one reviewer's dermatologist commented her skin looked good for her age.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry skin describe a hydrating, dewy finish that doesn't look greasy; no dissent noted.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers say it visibly covers redness and rosacea without irritation; one reviewer specifically credits it with not irritating rosacea-prone skin.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with eczema, allergies, or reactive skin report no burning, rash, or reaction, calling it gentle enough for compromised or reactive skin.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports it helps with melasma coverage and hyperpigmentation protection; not widely discussed elsewhere.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone skin say it doesn't cause breakouts and can be worn during flare-ups, but one reviewer with very sensitive skin reports it clogged pores badly and one mentions struggling with breakouts while using it.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers find it blends well and controls shine reasonably, but multiple say they still need a matte setting powder on top to prevent a dewy/shiny look.

extraits.titre: never will buy again, too many cons
extraits.texte: I love Avene products and use many from the skin care line with great success. This, however, was a total failure for me. First the pros... it goes on easily and stays on. If you need a sunscreen to last a long time, this may be it. The compact is convenient for a purse or on a trip. It is non-irritating. I have very sensitive skin and had zero irritation with this. Now the cons... It clogs pores. I have not had clogged pores this bad in years, and this product did it. It settles into lines in a huge way and looks terrible. It is very thick. The compact form is not very sanitary over the long term and the pad that comes with this is not going to last more than a week or two. The color range, 2 colors only, is not good at all. The lightest color is a little too dark for me. So I bought it once, and I will never buy it again. Very disappointed.

I bought this as a sunscreen, but I'm using it as a coverage/base product. I'm using it in the place of a tinted moisturizer or cc cream, and I think it will be great for summer. I'm 42 years old w/ dry, sensitive skin. I typically like base products w/ light coverage. I bought this thinking that it would work for mid-day sunscreen re-application. It could work that way, but I adore it as my base product. It leaves a beautiful sheen on my face that does not look greasy. I have light (between fair & medium) skin w/ neutral undertones. It looks waaayyy too dark in the compact, but blends beautifully. Even though I'm sure each shade suits a multitude of skin tones, a mere two shades will exclude lots & lots of people. Otherwise, it would have earned 5 stars.

This compact sunscreen is incredible. I use this instead of regular foundation. It is smooth and creamy but dries down beautifully on my mature, pale, dry skin. The colors are forgiving. I use the Beige all over and Honey as a contour. Excellent products.
medium coverage that does not irritate my rosacea. will be buying again

I'm been trying to be better about wearing sunblock over the last couple of years. I really hate the feel and smell of most sunscreens. But this stuff is incredible! I've loved avène for years (ran out of moisturizer on a trip to Paris and discovered this brand in a pharmacy there), and I'm so excited that it's now more accessible in the US! This SPF compact leaves a beautiful sheen and provides a lot of coverage that is easy to blend out. I typically only spot conceal, so it took a little time to get used to wearing something all over my skin, but the cream to powder formulation feels like nothing! Only downside is I wish there were more shades to choose from. I'm really fair, like usually a porcelain shade, and I ordered the beige and it actually goes on a lot lighter than it looks in the compact and blends in well (and also makes me look a little tanner, which is nice in the sunnier months). I have combination skin, like oily and peeling at the same time, and this does highlight some of the spots that are flaky but I really love how weightless this is! I also have very acne prone, sensitive skin and this didn't cause any breakouts.

I never write reviews but this compact deserves it. Im fair-medium skintone, so the beige was a good match, a little on the lighter side. It has spf which is a huge plus. But the thing that really sold me is how good it blends and how it does not bother my sensitive eczema-prone skin.
I absolutely love this product. It has enough tint that I don't need to wear makeup, is not greasy, and seems to stay all day. I also haven't broken out. The perfect solution for my melasma.
